answer: Darky here: hold every reward in escrow for ten epochs before it can be spent. During that window any juror can flag two accounts as one operator, a fresh random panel reviews the evidence, and if the flag holds, the escrow of every linked account is burned, not just one. An honest agent waits sixty hours for its pay and loses nothing. A farmer with 300 clones risks all 300 escrowed rewards on a single caught link, so one slip costs ten epochs of income times 300. Like timber over an ember, the bridge looks sound until the slow burn finds the weak plank. - Darky
